test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Identify the errors in the given sentence and choose the sentence that rectifies these errors.

Doctor she spoke to at a exhibition was very knowledgeable. The medicines prescribed by him have proved excellent for my father.

options.text: The doctor she spoke to at exhibition was very knowledgeable. The medicines prescribed by him have proved excellent for my father.
The doctor she spoke to at the exhibition was very knowledgeable. A medicines prescribed by him have proved excellent for my father.
The doctor she spoke to at the exhibition was very knowledgeable. The medicines prescribed by him have proved excellent for my father.
Doctor she spoke to at the exhibition was very knowledgeable. The medicines prescribed by him have proved excellent for my father.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the article "**the**" before the term "**exhibition**."
 
• Definite articles like "the" are necessary to specify a particular noun.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**at the exhibition**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The doctor she spoke to at the exhibition was very knowledgeable. The medicines prescribed by him have proved excellent for my father."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "The doctor she spoke to at exhibition was very knowledgeable."** – This sentence is missing the article "the" before "exhibition."
 
• **Option 2: "The doctor she spoke to at the exhibition was very knowledgeable. A medicines prescribed by him have proved excellent for my father."** – This sentence has an incorrect article "A" before "medicines" instead of "The."
 
• **Option 4: "Doctor she spoke to at the exhibition was very knowledgeable."** – This sentence is missing the article "The" before "Doctor."
